1.why: All nine screens use a static, uncluttered layout with no moving images or pop-ups visible.

2.why: Large headings, prominent blue buttons, labeled fields, progress bars, and highlighted next-step panels make important items stand out.

3.why: The primary form and action are easy to locate, although the persistent help panel and technical logs add some distraction.

4.why: Only one main step is presented at a time, with visible progress and next-step reminders reducing what the user must remember.

5.why: No password-manager prompt, autofill control, or remember-me option is visible in any screenshot.

6.why: No saved accounts, familiar identifiers, or other recognizable saved items are displayed.

7.why: The interface consistently uses short sentences, plain language, readable text, and clearly separated sections.

8.why: None of the screenshots shows an error state, so the clarity and corrective guidance of error messages cannot be observed.

9.why: Password rules are listed, but no concrete example password, email, patient reference, or code-entry example is shown.

10.why: Password and code entry are clearly labeled, but no alternative authentication choices such as face login are presented.

11.why: Each screen presents one primary action and at most one secondary navigation or pause option.

12.why: Next-step notices, activity logs, and the final green confirmation clearly communicate action outcomes.

13.why: Each new step includes brief instructions, a next-step reminder, and persistent access to help and safety advice.

14.why: Forms remain available for resubmission and several screens provide back navigation, although no explicit try-again message is shown.

15.why: Headings, fields, buttons, colors, help content, and page structure remain consistent across all nine screens.
